title: Birds and how they fly
examples: How do birds make their wings work?
What do birds use to fly really high?

explain.say: Look closely at these feathers. Feathers help birds fly and keep warm.
Birds have strong wings. Wings push against the air.
Many bird bones are hollow. Hollow bones make a bird lighter.
Birds fly by flapping their wings. They can also glide on the air with their wings held still.
When a bird flies, its whole body is working together. Feathers, wings and light bones all help.
Think about a kite in the wind. The wind holds it up, just as it helps a gliding bird.

faq.a: No, some birds cannot fly. Penguins are a good example of this.

faq.q: Are the hollow bones really strong?
faq.a: Yes, they are strong enough for flight but light enough to lift the bird.

faq.q: What is the difference between flapping and gliding?
faq.a: Flapping uses muscle power to push through air. Gliding uses air currents to float.
No. Feathers also keep the bird warm and dry.
asks: What else are feathers used for?
Do feathers only help with wings?

faq.a: Having hollow bones makes the bird much lighter. Being light helps the bird fly further.
asks: Why are bird bones not solid?

facts: Feathers provide insulation and help with flight.
Hollow bones reduce the bird's overall weight.
Birds flap their wings to create lift and thrust.
Gliding involves using wind currents to maintain altitude.

quiz.say: What do feathers do for a bird?

options.show: help it see in the dark
options.say: help it see in the dark

options.show: keep it warm and help it fly
options.say: keep it warm and help it fly

quiz.why: Feathers keep a bird warm. Wing feathers also help it fly.

wrong.0: Eyes help a bird see, and feathers cover its body.
wrong.2: A bird tastes with its mouth, and feathers cover its body.

quiz.say: Many bird bones are hollow. Why does that help?
quiz.why: Hollow bones weigh less, so the bird is light enough to fly.

wrong.1: A bird sings with its throat, and bones make no sound.

quiz.say: A bird moves its wings up and down to push the air. What is this called?
quiz.why: Moving wings up and down to push the air is flapping.

wrong.0: When a bird glides, its wings stay still.
wrong.1: When a bird rests, it sits still on a branch.
